designationHistory.indexText: National Wildlife Refuge Woodworth, ND Arrowwood Wetland Management District Arrowwood Wetland Management District was established in 1961 as a breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Devils Lake Wetland Management District, About Us

review.note: Draft sentence describes Arrowwood WMD (1961), not Devils Lake WMD. An FWS predator-management EA says only that Devils Lake WMD "was established in the early 1960s." Exact year not found.
